decisions.reason: As the flagship product line close to the core and aligned with digitalization of practices, it likely meets aspirations, and the growing firm has slack to carry it.
The education institute builds on established training resources and supports customer retention, so with a growing firm there is little shortfall to trigger search.
Remote support tools became more valuable during the pandemic and are cheap to maintain, so results likely meet aspirations.
The analytics dashboard builds on core software data and fits the firm's direction toward efficiently managed practices, so slack allows it to continue despite uncertain uptake.
A complete bundle is close to the core offer and packages existing products, giving low cost and satisfactory results.

The job portal is distant from core competencies and only mentioned on the site, so it faces the highest risk of falling short, but its low cost and the firm's growth-based slack make keeping it slightly more likely.
